tx_pending_beyond_deadline.meaning: the submitted transaction remains pending (unmined) past its intended deadline

executed_after_deadline.meaning: the delayed transaction is executed at a later time after its intended deadline

mev_disadvantage_occurs.meaning: malicious actors or MEV bots execute the delayed transaction at a disadvantage to the original submitter

assumptions: The deadline passed to the position manager is intended to be a real expiry for the transaction.
The delayed transaction is the same transaction submitted by the original submitter.

unresolved.description: The report states the delayed-execution harm only as a possibility and gives no concrete transaction, actor, or observed execution; the exact condition under which MEV disadvantage occurs is not defined.
No quantitative loss, amount, or asset value is reported for the MEV disadvantage.

limitations: The MEV disadvantage is represented as a grounded Boolean outcome because the report provides no numeric magnitude or concrete execution.
The plan formalizes only the mev_disadvantage impact; the separate delayed_execution impact is not covered by this claim.
